headers.//: CSS and JS are requested with a ?v=<content hash> appended by scripts/build.mjs, so a changed file always gets a new URL. Only for those is a one-year immutable cache actually true.
Media keeps stable filenames and can be replaced in place (the logo already was). Cache it, but revalidate, so a swapped asset appears within a day instead of being pinned for a year.
The HTML is what points at the versioned asset URLs, so it must never be served stale.
